build_pipeline_simple: build a pipeline from a PipelineConfig with a SourceConfig and no transformation pipes
build_pipeline_aggregate: build a pipeline that aggregates items into batches of three using the Aggregate pipe
build_pipeline_disaggregate: build a pipeline that flattens nested lists into individual items using the Disaggregate pipe
build_pipeline_pipe_lambda: build a pipeline that applies a lambda transformation to each item using the Pipe class
build_pipeline_pipe_dict: build a pipeline that maps input values to squared outputs using a dict as a Pipe
